jobs.name: indexed_join
jobs.sql: SELECT a.label, b.score FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id AND b.bucket <> 3 WHERE a.id = $1 ORDER BY b.id LIMIT 1

jobs.name: three_table_join
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id = $1 AND b.id = $1 AND c.id = $1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: three_table_join_range
jobs.sql: SELECT a.id, b.score, c.label FROM items a JOIN items b ON b.id = a.id JOIN items c ON c.id = b.id WHERE a.id < $1 AND b.id < $1 AND c.id < $1 ORDER BY a.id

jobs.name: nested_key
jobs.sql: SELECT id, label FROM expr_items WHERE (a + b) * 2 = $1 ORDER BY id

jobs.name: reversed_key
jobs.sql: SELECT id, label FROM expr_items WHERE $1 = (a + b) * 2 ORDER BY id

jobs.name: different_key
jobs.sql: SELECT id, label FROM expr_items WHERE (b + a) * 2 = $1 ORDER BY id

jobs.name: partial_match
jobs.sql: SELECT id, label FROM expr_items WHERE a + b = $1 AND enabled = true ORDER BY id

jobs.name: partial_mismatch
jobs.sql: SELECT id, label FROM expr_items WHERE a + b = $1 AND enabled = false ORDER BY id

jobs.name: compound_text
jobs.sql: SELECT id, label FROM expr_items WHERE bucket = 2 AND lower(label) = $1 ORDER BY id
